sample.program.bells.note: Twenty-five minutes, two times every week, for di weeks wey time no dey.
sample.program.engine.name: Engine 8
sample.program.engine.note: Three days every week. Every two weeks, di intervals go dey longer and di rest go dey shorter.
sample.program.strong.name: Strong in 12
sample.program.strong.note: Three lifting days every week. We dey film every top set, and you go get note back.
sample.replay.bike.body: Forty seconds on, eighty off. Di pace hold reach di last round, so next week di rest go dey shorter.
sample.replay.bike.title: Air bike intervals
sample.replay.circuit.body: Four rounds of sled push, farmer carry and ten burpees. Every round fast pass di one before.
sample.replay.circuit.title: Sled, carries and burpees
sample.replay.press.body: Feet set, shoulder blades lock, one-second pause for chest. Five clean sets.
sample.replay.press.title: Bench press, sets of five
sample.replay.pull.body: Every rep start from dead stop, no bounce. Rows strict, chest for di bench.
sample.replay.pull.title: Deadlift and rows
sample.replay.squat.body: Pause di first rep of every set. Bar speed hold reach di last triple, so di weight go up next week.
sample.replay.squat.title: Back squat, heavy triples
sample.replay.swings.body: Thirty swings for di top of every two minutes. Hips snap, arms just hold am.
sample.replay.swings.title: Kettlebell swings, every two minutes
sample.review.r1: +60 lb for my deadlift inside 14 weeks, and my back no pain me even one day.
sample.review.r2: World-class programming. E dey book up fast, so plan ahead. E worth am.
sample.review.r3: Every session get note wey dey wait after. Finally I sabi why di program be how e be.
sample.review.r4: I never touch barbell before. Eight months later I pull two times my body weight.
